title_zh: 中国加入世界贸易组织
title_en: Chinese History (15/20): China Joins the World Trade Organization
note_en: 长达 ("lasting as long as") goes right before a length of time to stress that it was long: 经过长达十五年的艰苦谈判 "after fifteen long years of tough negotiations." The whole phrase 长达十五年的 then sits in front of the noun with 的, where English would use "fifteen long years of" or "that dragged on for fifteen years." 长达 also works with distances and sizes: 长达一千五百页 would be "a full 1,500 pages."
